name: @dorkos/keep-awake
description: Keeps the computer from idle-sleeping while work is in flight: a reference-counted hold over one OS tool per platform (caffeinate, systemd-inhibit, SetThreadExecutionState), tied to the owning process so it can never outlive it.

scripts.smoke: node -e "process.platform==='darwin'||(console.error('keep-awake smoke: macOS only (it drives /usr/bin/caffeinate and pmset)'),process.exit(1))" && DORKOS_KEEP_AWAKE_SMOKE=1 vitest run src/__tests__/caffeinate.smoke.test.ts --silent=false --reporter=verbose
